record_count_definition: Six project or phase records, not six proven distinct campuses. Mount Pleasant phases share one location; Atlanta Fairwater has not been reconciled to the other Georgia records.
coverage: Selected Microsoft examples; neither a representative sample nor a complete pipeline. Status statements are dated to their sources, not certified current on retrieval.
capacity_rule: verified_capacity_mw remains null unless a source establishes this project's electrical-load capacity and phase. Solar generation, rack power, and building counts cannot fill it.
permit_rule: permit_verified means an applicable authority's actual project permit record has been reviewed; issuer descriptions alone do not satisfy this field.

projects.model_link: METHOD: Operating-case diligence on utilization, replacement spending, energy costs and service resilience. Historical commissioning-delay assumptions must not be presented as this facility's current status.
projects.evidence_gap: Site-level cash flow, commissioned electrical load, tariff and water-use measurements; applicable permit records.
projects.next_trigger: Obtain operating disclosures or authority records that link a measured quantity to this phase.
